reader_question: How many super PACs are there, and how has that changed?
grade_line: Documented: the Federal Election Commission’s records
title: The Federal Election Commission’s totals held 2,062 super PACs in the 2024 election cycle, more than 25 times the 80 of 2010.
measure_line: Super PACs, committees that may raise and spend unlimited sums for or against candidates but may not give to them, in the commission’s financial totals for each two-year election cycle, named for the year it ends, from 2010, the first cycle the totals list any, to 2024, United States
source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, financial totals for PACs and party committees, independent expenditure-only committees, known as super PACs, counted by two-year cycle, 2009 to 2010 through 2023 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Hybrid PACs, which also make independent expenditures, are not counted.
notes: A late or amended filing can change a past cycle’s count; these are the commission’s totals on November 12, 2026.
alt: Eight columns of super PACs, one for each two-year cycle: 2010 80, 2012 857, 2014 956, 2016 1,377, 2018 1,454, 2020 1,800, 2022 1,884, 2024 2,062, the last in red.
